definition.name: Collect funds from external bank into core CreditBalance

payload.purpose: Cross-bank collection TCC Saga: debit an external bank clearing order (source: ExternalTransferOrder) and credit the investor's core bank account (target: CreditBalance) with explicit singleton serial barriers.
invariants: Currency and exact minor units are conserved across interbank clearing and core account credit

definition.name: Reserve and deduct core bank funds for mutual fund subscription

payload.purpose: Fund subscription payment TCC Saga: reserve and deduct funds from the investor's core CreditBalance (source) and confirm payment on the FundOrder aggregate (target) before T+1 TA submission.
invariants: Core bank account deduction and fund order settled subscription amount are strictly conserved
